title: Machine Learning Foundations
promise: Build simple models while understanding what they learn, how they fail, and whether they add value.

modules.title: Frame the prediction problem
modules.mental_model: Machine learning learns a repeatable relationship from examples; first define the decision, prediction, and consequence.
common_mistakes: starts with an algorithm instead of a problem
uses a target unavailable at prediction time
understanding_checks: What happens when the prediction is wrong?
projects: frame a synthetic support-ticket priority predictor

modules.title: Features, labels, and baselines
modules.mental_model: Features are clues available to the model; the label is the answer it learns to predict; a baseline is the simplest honest comparison.
evidence: compares model value with the baseline
common_mistakes: includes the answer among the clues
assumes any trained model is useful
understanding_checks: Would this feature exist when making a real prediction?
What would a no-model baseline do?

modules.title: Separate learning from evaluation
modules.mental_model: A test set is hidden homework: the model must not see it while learning or while you make training decisions.
evidence: explains why the test set stays untouched
common_mistakes: uses test results repeatedly to tune the model
understanding_checks: Which data is the model allowed to learn from?
When may the test set be used?

modules.title: Preprocess without leakage
modules.mental_model: Preprocessing learns rules from training data and then applies those same rules to unseen data.
evidence: fits preprocessing on training data only
common_mistakes: fits an encoder on the test set
drops rows differently at prediction time
understanding_checks: Which step is learning from data?
What information could leak from the test set?

modules.title: Train and predict
modules.mental_model: Training adjusts a model using examples; prediction applies the learned relationship to new feature values.
common_mistakes: uses a complex model before a simple one
projects: train a simple synthetic ticket classifier

modules.title: Measure the errors that matter
modules.mental_model: A metric turns prediction errors into a score; the right metric reflects the real cost of different mistakes.
common_mistakes: uses accuracy for an imbalanced problem
understanding_checks: Can this score hide a weak minority class?
projects: compare precision and recall for synthetic spam filtering

modules.title: Overfitting and cross-validation
modules.mental_model: A useful model learns a pattern that survives new examples, not the accidental details of its training set.
common_mistakes: chooses the model with the best training score
treats one split as universal truth

modules.title: Interpret and document limitations
modules.mental_model: Interpretation describes model behavior and evidence; it does not prove causation or guarantee fairness.
understanding_checks: What does this interpretation not prove?
Where should this model not be used?
projects: write a model card for the synthetic classifier
